title: Failure of fixed-profile modified scattering and generalized modified scattering for the 1D defocusing cubic NLS
summary: We study the long-time behavior of the one-dimensional defocusing cubic nonlinear Schrödinger equation with initial data in $L^2(\mathbb R)$. We first prove that the standard fixed-profile modified-scattering ansatz fails at the unweighted $L^2$ endpoint for the one-dimensional defocusing cubic nonlinear Schrödinger equation. More precisely, there exists a real-valued datum $$u_*\in L^1(\mathbb R)\cap\bigcap_{m\in\mathbb N}H^m(\mathbb R), \qquad xu_*\notin L^2(\mathbb R).,$$ for which the corrected Fourier profile has no strong $L^2$ limit.
